en: You beat Burgh? Then you're just the Trainer I was waiting for!
My family's Eevee had more little ones than our flat can hold. One of them keeps staring at the gate to Route 4.
Would you take it with you on your journey?
Eevee can grow into so many different Pokémon. I can't wait to hear which one it chooses!
Oh... Well, it'll be right here if you change your mind.
Your team looks full. Make some room, then come back for it!
How's Eevee doing? Has it chosen what it wants to be yet?
Beyond Route 4 lies Nimbasa City. I hear its Gym Leader is a model!
